verdict.rationale: A public API for listing mail and downloading scans is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers access through a phone app and web portal. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404, and no documented developer API appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list mail items and download scans through a documented public API — my systems ingest postal mail like any other data source
